title: BQ27220 Technical Reference Manual
sections: 1.1.10 Initial Battery Capacity at Device Reset

writeScope.target: BQ27220 volatile RAM, not OTP or ETA6098 charger

implementationNotes: UNSEALED CONFIG UPDATE confirmed on actual board; no FULL ACCESS required for this transaction.
Short address+4-byte capacity write follows bundled espressif/bq27220 setter; 32-byte readback verifies remaining 28 bytes.
Standard FCC refresh lags CFGUPDATE exit; poll at 100ms for at most 3 seconds.
